idea-plugin.name: Varro: OpenJet
idea-plugin.description:
OpenCode workbench for JetBrains IDEs

Use OpenCode in IntelliJ IDEA, WebStorm, PyCharm, GoLand, DataGrip and other JetBrains IDEs. Ask questions about your project, plan changes and review AI-generated edits without leaving the IDE.

Features

  • Run parallel chat sessions in the tool window, editor tabs or detached IDE windows.
  • Add files, editor selections, terminal output and project errors and warnings as context. In IDEs with Database Tools, attach table schemas and selected rows.
  • Review plans, tool activity and file diffs. Control permissions per session or project.
  • Enable background desktop alerts and per-event sounds for permissions, questions, completed replies and plans ready for review.
  • Choose models and agents, view API pricing and provider quotas, and track token usage across projects.
  • Generate commit messages from your Git changes.
  • Connect to OpenCode V1 or V2 with automatic version detection, and import V1 conversations into V2.

Varro OpenJet brings the Varro chat interface from VS Code to the IntelliJ Platform. It uses your existing OpenCode configuration for providers, models, agents, commands, skills and MCP servers.

Requirements

  • A JetBrains IDE 2025.2 or newer with a JCEF-enabled runtime. Detached chat window commands require IDE 2026.1 or newer.
  • OpenCode CLI V2 2.0.5 or newer, or V1 1.16.0 or newer, on PATH or configured in Settings | Tools | Varro. Install V2 with npm install -g @opencode/cli.
  • A configured provider. Run opencode auth login, or use /connect in the chat.

Network and credential disclosure

  • Chat requests go through a local OpenCode server. Varro can discover a registered V2 service, connect on the configured port, or start a server when needed.
  • Provider-limit polling contacts provider quota endpoints directly.
  • Provider-limit polling uses existing provider credentials in the IDE host, including supported OAuth refresh. The webview receives quota counters and statuses, not credentials.
  • Terminal commands the chat can request are restricted to a fixed allowlist of OpenCode authentication, install and upgrade commands.
idea-plugin.change-notes:
0.7.x

  • Global vision-agent assignment, automatic image delegation and delegated-vision badges.
  • Improved file links and scrolling when returning to background chats.
  • Shared server ownership with VS Code Varro and safer restart recovery.
  • Fixed startup loading, skill insertion and chat handoffs.
  • Optional background alerts and sounds.
  • History image previews, faster loading and smoother streaming and send scrolling.
  • Pending background task and compaction indicators, with session filtering.
  • Automatic compaction settings are managed by OpenCode; on-demand compaction remains available.
  • Remembered model choices, reliable queued model selection and model preferences, Codex credits and quota-reset reminders.

0.6.x

  • Keep drafts, attachments and model choices when a provider is unavailable; resume cancelled work without duplicate prompts.
  • Status-bar connection details and warnings for outdated CLI or server versions.
  • Fixed streaming jumps and IME input; improved prompt navigation and model-speed labels.

0.5.x

  • Compress image attachments with size previews and an option to restore the original.
  • Reopen or implement skipped plans, and mark filtered session lists as read.
  • Clearer steering messages and more reliable timers, prompt history and diff scrolling.

0.4.x

  • DataGrip context includes active datasources, SQL and related database objects.
  • Turn navigation with hover previews, custom agent icons and quota-expiration warnings.
  • Clearer provider errors and retry countdowns; improved scrolling and macOS editing shortcuts.

0.3.x

  • OpenCode V2 support alongside V1, automatic server discovery and V1 conversation import.
  • Pause and resume sessions, view costs including subagents, and paste long text or matching editor and terminal selections as attachments.
  • Shared servers across Varro hosts, saved server credentials, optional TypeSafe Jev permission review and controls for discovered local providers.

0.2.x

  • Support for JetBrains IDEs from 2025.2 without an upper build limit.
  • Model API pricing and provider quota details; permission prompts identify subagent requests.

0.1.x

  • OpenCode chat for JetBrains IDEs with parallel sessions, plan and change review, model and permission controls, and usage reports.
  • Detached chat windows and per-chat light/dark toggles.
  • Database schemas, selected rows and project problems as context; table drag-and-drop and @ mentions.
  • Shared settings across JetBrains IDEs, a read-only Ask agent and synced session selections.
  • Fixed file drops and native editing shortcuts; improved streaming, diffs and scrolling.
